  "w01": "At dawn, the lighthouse keeper found a bottle wedged in the kelp, its cork blackened and sealed with wax. Inside was a folded map, brittle with salt, and a note written in hurried ink. It gave no name, only a date from forty years before and a bearing toward a reef where no chart marked shelter. The keeper turned the paper in the lantern light, watching the waves roll over the very rocks described. That night, he kept the beam turning as always, but he placed the bottle on his shelf and wondered how many prayers the sea had carried, answered, and then quietly returned. Outside, the wind seemed to answer with a low, patient sigh.",
  "w02": "凌晨四点，城市浸在深蓝的寂静里。高楼窗灯零星亮着，像未睡的眼睛。街道刚被雨水洗过，路灯把光铺在湿亮的路面。偶尔一辆出租车驶过，划破宁静，又很快远去。便利店透出暖黄灯光，店员安静地整理货架。远处天桥空无一人，只有风穿过栏杆。早点铺升起白雾，香气漫到巷口。天边尚未泛白，城市在梦中轻轻呼吸，等待第一缕晨光唤醒。",
  "w03": "- Recursion is when a task asks itself to solve a smaller version of the same task.\n- Each smaller task keeps going until it reaches a simple stopping case that needs no more help.\n- Then the answers pass back upward, one step at a time, until the original task is solved."
